* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-xizorspalacesewer022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/xizorspalacesewer.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/xizorspalacesewer.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Xizor's Palace: Sewer (Errata)]]): Errata-sheet slip, Errata Sheet 2020 Spring (official text as of 22 March 2020)<ref name="sheet-2020-03-22">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/March_2020_Errata.pdf Errata Sheet 2020 Spring] (Players Committee), page 1; PDF built 22 March 2020. Listed on the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips page] (Internet Archive, 20 September 2024).</ref> — the cut-out slip the PC published for sleeving over the card (an errata-sheet slip is its own version, separate from the PC card image of the same errata; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed:''' the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the art credit line reads “Image courtesy of Jonathan Drufesne” (the name misspelled); the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Swamp (Dark)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a Corellian. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an alien in hand with a non-spy Black Sun agent in Lost Pile.”
